optionFaviconCacheClearConfirm.description: Confirmation shown before clearing the favicon cache.

optionFaviconCacheEmpty.description: Alert shown when the user clicks Clear icon cache and no cache keys exist.

optionFaviconCacheCleared.message: Icon cache cleared. Icons will be re-fetched on next open.
optionFaviconCacheCleared.description: Alert shown after clearing the favicon cache.

favGalleryLink.description: Options link (Icons group, right of the Clear icon cache button): opens the favicon gallery page listing the sites whose icons were refetched.

favGalleryTitle.description: Favicon gallery page title (h1 + document title).

favGalleryHint.message: Icons vBookmarks fetched for bookmarked sites Chrome had not cached — where each one came from and which bookmarks use it. Display only.
favGalleryHint.description: Subtitle under the favicon gallery title, explaining the page is read-only.

favGallerySearch.message: Filter by site, title or path
favGallerySearch.description: Placeholder of the favicon gallery filter input.

favGalleryAll.description: Favicon gallery source filter chip: show every source.

favSrcDirect.description: Favicon gallery source badge: the icon was fetched directly from the site itself.

favSrcProxy.description: Favicon gallery source badge: the icon was fetched through the user's own proxy relay.

favSrcLegacy.description: Favicon gallery source badge: cached before the source was recorded, so the origin is unknown.

favGalleryCompare.description: Favicon gallery toggle button: switch every icon to the generic placeholder it replaced (before/after comparison).

favGalleryShowingBefore.description: Favicon gallery toggle button while the placeholder comparison is shown: switch back to the real fetched icons.

favGalleryStatSites.description: Favicon gallery stats strip: how many sites have a refreshed icon.

favGalleryStatBookmarks.description: Favicon gallery stats strip: how many bookmarks sit on the refreshed sites.

favGalleryVisits.description: Favicon gallery tooltip on a bookmark row's visit-count pill.

favGalleryFailedTitle.description: Favicon gallery heading of the muted section listing hosts whose icon fetch failed recently.

favGalleryFailedHint.message: Failures are retried after 24 h, 3 days and 7 days, then given up until the icon cache is cleared.
favGalleryFailedHint.description: Favicon gallery hint under the failed-fetch section title.

favGalleryGaveUp.description: Favicon gallery badge on a failed-strip host whose retries are exhausted (it stays untouched until the icon cache is cleared).

favGalleryOrphan.message: No bookmark left on this host — the icon clears with the cache.
favGalleryOrphan.description: Favicon gallery note on a card whose host no longer has any bookmark.

favGalleryEmptyText.message: When the popup meets a bookmarked site Chrome has no icon for, vBookmarks fetches the real one and lists it here.

storageUsageIcon.description: Storage usage bar legend segment: bytes held by the favicon cache.

storageUsageOther.description: Storage usage bar legend segment: bytes held by settings and any other data.

storageUsageFree.description: Storage usage bar legend segment: remaining space in chrome.storage.local.

storageUsageHint.message: Local extension storage only (chrome.storage.local, about 10 MB quota): the icon cache plus settings and other local data. Synced settings, session data and the bookmark library itself are not counted here.
storageUsageHint.description: Hint under the storage usage bar in the Icons group.

optionsDonate.description: Options page header button linking to the donation page.

optionsGithubLink.description: Options page header link to the GitHub profile/repository.

optionsHomepageLink.description: Options page header link to the plugin homepage.

optionsSince.message: Forked from Neat Bookmarks, maintained for $days$ days.
optionsSince.description: Subtitle under the options page title: days since the 1.0 fork from Neat Bookmarks.

optionsVersion.description: Tooltip for the version number shown at the top-right of the options page.

statsSortByCount.description: Stats view sort segment: order rows by visit count, highest first.

statsSortByRecent.description: Stats view sort segment: order rows by most recent visit first.

statsShowUnbookmarkedHint.message: Include pages from your history that are not saved as bookmarks.

statsEmpty.message: Statistics build up as you open bookmarks
statsEmpty.description: Empty state of the stats view when no visit data has been collected yet.

statsDisabledHint.message: Visit statistics are off — enable them in Options → Views
statsDisabledHint.description: Stats view empty state shown instead of data when the statsEnabled switch is off.

statsVisitCount.description: Aria label of the stats row count pill; $count$ is the visit count.

statsClearData.description: Button (stats view toolbar and options page) that wipes all collected visit statistics.

statsClearConfirm.message: Clear visit statistics for $count$ bookmarks? This cannot be undone.
statsClearConfirm.description: Confirmation dialog text before wiping visit statistics; $count$ is the number of bookmark entries.

statsHistoryBanner.message: Grant history access to seed visit statistics with your past visits.
statsHistoryBanner.description: Banner text on top of the recent view: invites granting the optional history permission so visit statistics can be seeded with past visits.

statsHistoryEnable.description: Link inside the recent view's history-permission banner: requests the optional history permission.

statsHistoryDismiss.description: aria-label of the dismiss button on the recent view's history-permission banner.

statsHistoryImported.description: Toast after the history import finished; $count$ is how many bookmarks received a seeded visit count.

paletteCmdThemeUsage.message: Usage: /theme followed by a theme name — auto, light, dark, ink or paper (a unique prefix works, e.g. /theme d).

paletteCustomDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the command "$1"? The change syncs to all your devices.

paletteCustomBroken.message: The folder of command "$1" no longer exists. Delete the command?

paletteCustomHint.message: Custom slash commands for the command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K). They sync with your settings — 100 entries max.

paletteCustomTemplate.message: URL template — %s is replaced by the words after the command

paletteCustomErrSlash.message: Slash: 1–24 chars of lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

paletteCustomErrAlias.message: Aliases: same rules as the slash (1–24 chars of lowercase letters, digits or hyphens).

paletteCustomErrTaken.message: That slash or alias is already taken.

paletteCustomErrUrl.message: Only http:// or https:// URLs are allowed.

paletteCustomErrTemplate.message: The template must contain exactly one %s.

paletteCustomErrLimit.message: Command limit reached (100) — delete one first.

settingsBackupHint.message: Export saves all settings (including sync preferences) to a JSON file. Import merges a backup back: settings in the file overwrite the current ones, everything else is kept.

settingsImportConfirm.message: Importing will overwrite every setting contained in the backup file (settings not in the file are kept) and reload this page. Continue?

settingsImportInvalid.message: Invalid settings file: not a vBookmarks settings backup.

settingsImportDone.message: Settings imported. The page will now reload.

settingsImportError.message: Some settings could not be written (storage quota or a transient error). The import did not complete — please try again.

statsHistoryGuide.message: Grant history access to list your recent visits here.

whatsNewTabGroups.message: v$1$ adds the Tab groups view: every window's tabs and tab groups, next to your bookmarks.

viewHiddenTabsHint.message: You're in the $view$ view. Press $back$ or use the command palette to return to the tree.

viewTabGroups.description: View tab title for the browser tabs + tab groups view.

optionShowTabGroupsView.message: Show the tab groups view tab

tabGroupsCurrentTab.description: Compact pill on the row of the tab that is active in its window (the row tint + pill together mark it).

tabGroupsSaveFolder.message: Save tab group as bookmark folder

tabGroupsCopyMoveDialog.message: Selected tabs already belong to a tab group. Copy them (open in a new place) or move them (remove from their current group)?

tabGroupsClosedToast.description: Toast after closing a single tab or tab group; the action button reopens it.

tabGroupsSleptToast.description: Toast after sleeping a single tab or tab group; the action button wakes it.

tabGroupsBatchClosedTitle.description: Title of the merged recently-closed record a batch close writes (one record for the whole selection).

tabGroupsPinnedUngroupedToast.message: Pinned — removed from its tab group
tabGroupsPinnedUngroupedToast.description: Toast when pinning a tab that belonged to a group: Chrome forbids pinned grouped tabs, so the tab leaves the group.

tabGroupsReopenAction.description: Toast action button: reopens the just-closed tab or tab group.

tabGroupsWakeAction.description: Toast action button: wakes the just-slept tab(s).

tabGroupsRecordDeletedToast.description: Toast after deleting one recently-closed record; Undo restores it.

tabGroupsClosedTabRemovedToast.description: Toast after removing one tab from a closed record; Undo restores it.

tabGroupsClearedToast.description: Toast after clearing all recently-closed records; Undo restores the whole list.

tabGroupsSelectAddBookmarks.description: Selection-mode toolbar button in the tab groups view: adds the selected tabs as bookmarks into a chosen bookmark folder.

paletteCmdGoTabGroups.description: Command palette entry: switch to the tab groups view (slash alias /tabgroups, /groups).

tabGroupsActivateGroup.description: Group-head action in the tab groups view: focuses the group's first tab.

tabGroupsRenameGroup.description: Group-head action in the tab groups view: opens the title/color dialog for the group.

tabGroupsRenameDialog.description: Heading of the tab-group dialog when opened from the tab groups view to rename a group.

tabGroupsCloseGroup.description: Group-head action in the tab groups view: closes every tab of the group.

tabGroupsSleepGroup.description: Group-head action in the tab groups view: discards every tab of the group.

tabGroupsWakeGroup.description: Group header control/menu item in the tab groups view: wake every sleeping member.

tabGroupsActivateTab.description: Tab row context-menu item in the tab groups view: focuses the tab.

tabGroupsCollapseGroup.description: Tab group context-menu item in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsExpandGroup.description: Tab group context-menu item in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsMenuAddBookmark.description: Tab row context-menu item in the tab groups view: bookmarks the tab.

tabGroupsMenuSaveFolder.description: Tab group context-menu item in the tab groups view: saves the group as a bookmark folder.

tabGroupsSyncCollapse.description: Toolbar checkbox in the tab groups view: when checked, collapsing/expanding groups in the view also collapses/expands the browser tab groups.

tabGroupsSyncCollapseHint.message: When checked, collapsing or expanding a group in this view also updates the browser tab group. Off by default so view folding stays local.
tabGroupsSyncCollapseHint.description: Tooltip for the collapse-sync checkbox in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsColorStyle.description: Options page (Views group): how a tab group's color is drawn in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsColorStyleHint.message: Off shows the color dot only. Edge color band draws a colored strip down the group's left edge. Color connector line draws a colored line under the group's dot with a tick per row, tying the whole group into one tree.
tabGroupsColorStyleHint.description: Hint for the tab group color style selector on the options page.

tabGroupsColorStyleOff.description: Tab group color style choice on the options page.

tabGroupsColorStyleEdge.description: Tab group color style choice on the options page.

tabGroupsColorStyleLine.description: Tab group color style choice on the options page.

tabGroupsBookmarked.description: Accessible label of the always-visible filled star on tab rows that are already bookmarked.

tabGroupsRemoveBookmark.description: Tab row control/menu item in the tab groups view: delete the bookmark(s) for this tab's URL again.

tabGroupsBookmarkRemoved.description: Toast after removing a tab's bookmark from the tab groups view.

tabGroupsPinned.description: Status icon aria/tooltip on pinned tab rows in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsDiscarded.description: Status icon aria/tooltip on discarded (sleeping) tab rows in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsPinTab.description: Tab row context-menu item in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsUnpinTab.description: Tab row context-menu item in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsSleepTab.description: Tab row control/menu item in the tab groups view: discard the tab (hollow crescent).

tabGroupsWakeTab.description: Tab row control/menu item in the tab groups view: reload a sleeping tab in place (filled crescent).

tabGroupsOpenGroups.description: Section heading in the tab groups view for expanded groups.

tabGroupsClosedGroups.description: Section heading in the tab groups view for collapsed groups.

tabGroupsUngroupedTabs.description: Section heading in the tab groups view for tabs without a group.

tabGroupsUngroupGroup.description: Group context-menu item: remove the group but keep its tabs.

tabGroupsMoveNewWindow.description: Group context-menu item: move every tab of the group to a new window.

tabGroupsWindow.description: Window section heading in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsCurrentWindow.description: Badge on the window section heading that contains the popup.

tabGroupsReopenGroup.description: Button on a closed tab group row: reopens its tabs as a group.

tabGroupsDeleteClosedGroup.description: Button on a closed tab group row: removes the saved record.

tabGroupsCollapseWindow.description: Window-head toggle in the tab groups view: folds the window section.

tabGroupsCloseWindow.description: Hover action on a window section head: closes the whole window (confirm; tabs land as one merged closed record).

tabGroupsWindowClosedTitle.description: Title of the merged recently-closed record a window close writes.

tabGroupsExpandWindow.description: Window-head toggle in the tab groups view: unfolds the window section.

tabGroupsClearClosedGroups.description: Button on the closed tab groups section heading: removes all saved closed-group records.

tabGroupsConfirmClearClosed.message: Clear all recently closed records? They can no longer be reopened from here.
tabGroupsConfirmClearClosed.description: Confirmation dialog before clearing the tab groups view's recently-closed records list.

tabGroupsFilterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the instant filter input in the tab groups view toolbar: filters the listed tabs by title or URL.

tabGroupsNoMatchingTabs.description: Empty state in the tab groups view when the toolbar filter matches no open tab.

tabGroupsClosedOpenTab.description: Hover action on a saved tab inside a closed tab group row.

tabGroupsRemoveClosedTab.description: Hover action on a saved tab inside a closed tab group row: removes that tab from the saved record.

tabGroupsClosedTimeLabel.description: Tooltip label before the close time of a recently closed tab in the tab groups view.

tabGroupsExpandedExpand.description: Context-menu item for a recently closed tab group in the tab groups view: show its tabs.

tabGroupsExpandedCollapse.description: Context-menu item for a recently closed tab group in the tab groups view: hide its tabs.

optionTabGroupsClosedLimit.description: Options-page select in the Views group: how many closed tab/group records the tab groups view remembers.

folderPickFavNote.message: Unbookmarked items will be bookmarked here

stagingFull.message: The staging area is full — remove some items first

stagingFolderEmpty.message: This folder has no bookmarks to stage

stagingEmpty.message: Empty — right-click any bookmark, use the ↑ button here, or stats history rows to send items to the staging area

stagingGroupDissolved.message: Group dissolved — items kept in the staging area

stagingMoveConfirm.message: Move $n$ item(s) to the chosen folder?

stagingDeleteConfirm.message: Delete $n$ item(s)? Unbookmarked ones just leave the staging area.

stagingRemovedCount.message: Removed $n$ item(s) from the staging area

stagingClearConfirm.message: Clear the whole staging area? The bookmark tree is not touched.

groupPlaceTooltip.message: Save this group to a folder…

cutToast.message: Cut: $t$ — paste into a target folder (Esc cancels)

pasteGone.message: The bookmark no longer exists — clipboard cleared

optionCollapseAddFolderMenuHint.message: Merge the three add-folder entries (before/after/inside) into one submenu entry on folder right-clicks.

tabgroupStageNone.message: No bookmarkable tabs in this group
